question: How many cumulative 2026 human screwworm (gusano barrenador) cases will Honduras report as of early October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Resolves off the LATEST qualifying Sesal-attributed figure announced on or before Oct 1, not off true incidence. 299 was announced Sep 16 and repeated Sep 18, so the floor is effectively 299 and annulment is out. Announcement gaps in this series ran 22, 8, 18, 17, 20, 16, 34 days (mean ~19) - only one of seven was <=13 days, the length of the remaining window - so roughly 45% of the mass sits at exactly 299. Pushing the other way: Sesal issued a Distrito Central health alert on Sep 16, miasis is one of the 65 notifiable diseases under weekly ENO surveillance, and crossing the psychologically salient 300 (all of 2025) is a headline every Honduran outlet is waiting to run. Conditional on a new figure, recent velocity of ~1.2 cases/day since Aug 13 plus a 0-8 day reporting lag implies roughly +5 to +20, centered near 311. No market exists on this question. Downside escape (<290) requires a downward revision of 10+ cases, explicitly permitted by the fine print but unprecedented here; upside escape (>380) needs a reclassification batch folding suspected into confirmed.
sources: Polymarket / Manifold market search - no matching contract found
calls.dossier:
RESOLUTION INSTRUMENT: resolves off the cumulative 2026 human-case figure that Sesal (or credible press attributing it to Sesal) ANNOUNCES on or before 2026-10-01 - not off true incidence, and not off any figure Sesal holds internally but does not publish. Fine print: if several qualifying figures exist, the one announced LATEST on or before Oct 1 governs, including a downward revision. Animal cases excluded.

EVENT WINDOW: 2026-01-01 -> 2026-10-01 per the criteria (calendar-2026 cumulative count, figures announced through Oct 1); as of 2026-09-21T07:16Z, ~96% elapsed (263 of 274 days). A qualifying figure already exists, so annulment is not live.

ANNOUNCED SERIES (all attributed to Sesal / Unidad de Vigilancia de la Salud, jefe Homer Mejia):
- 2026-01 (mid-month): 3 cumulative (per question background).
- 2026-04-14/15: 99 SUSPECTED cases reported, awaiting lab confirmation; first 2026 death announced (Prensa Latina; Infobae 2026-04-15). Note this was a suspected, not confirmed, count.
- 2026-05-04: 141 cumulative, two deaths (Infobae, La Prensa, swissinfo).
- 2026-05-26: 176 cumulative, third death confirmed (swissinfo, RPP, Prensa Latina).
- 2026-06-03: 184 cumulative (question background).
- 2026-06-21: 191 cumulative, three deaths (La Prensa, El Pais HN, Infobae).
- 2026-07-08: 232 cumulative (icndigital).
- 2026-07-28: 246 cumulative, three deaths (Infobae).
- 2026-08-13: 257 cumulative (El Heraldo).
- 2026-09-16: 299 cumulative, three deaths (one Olancho, two Distrito Central), announced alongside a Sesal health alert for the Distrito Central (Hondudiario, La Prensa, Infobae 09-17, Canal 6 09-17, tunota, Azteca Honduras, extradigital).
- 2026-09-18: two separate outlets covering a Sesal multi-disease surveillance update (dengue, sarampion, tos ferina, miasis) still cite 299; El Heraldo 09-18 states 299 explicitly (El Heraldo, La Prensa). No figure above 299 located as of 2026-09-21.

OBSERVED INCREMENTS (derived from the above, per 15 days): May04->May26 ~24; May26->Jun03 ~15; Jun03->Jun21 ~6; Jun21->Jul08 ~36; Jul08->Jul28 ~11; Jul28->Aug13 ~10; Aug13->Sep16 ~19. Full-period Jul 8 -> Sep 16: +67 over 70 days (~0.96/day). Most recent segment Aug 13 -> Sep 16: +42 over 34 days (~1.24/day).

ANNOUNCEMENT-CADENCE BASE RATES: gaps between the eight located 2026 announcements were 22, 8, 18, 17, 20, 16, 34 days (mean ~19, median 18). Over ALL gaps, 1 of 7 was 13 days or shorter. Conditional on the period since the Sep 16 alert (heightened media and official activity), no comparable prior episode exists in this series to condition on. Remaining window from the last located announcement (Sep 18) to the deadline: 13 days.

MECHANISMS FAVOURING A FRESH FIGURE BEFORE OCT 1: Sesal issued a Distrito Central health alert on 2026-09-16 and stated it is maintaining active vigilance; miasis is one of Honduras's 65 Enfermedades de Notificacion Obligatoria (ENO) under routine weekly surveillance; the count stands one case below the 300 reported for all of 2025, a threshold Honduran outlets have explicitly flagged in advance; at least eight outlets carried the Sep 16-18 figure, indicating standing press demand.

MECHANISMS FAVOURING NO FRESH FIGURE: salud.gob.hn's front page carries no standing miasis case counter - the homepage links only to generic 'Alertas Epidemiologicas' and a 'Sala de Situacion' via the Portal de Emergencia Salud, and a direct fetch surfaced no miasis figure; figures have reached the public via periodic press briefings rather than a fixed publication calendar; the two largest historical gaps (22 and 34 days) both exceed the remaining window.

OTHER CONTEXT: a peer-reviewed epidemiological characterization (LATAM Revista Latinoamericana, Honduras 2025) reports 306 CONFIRMED 2025 cases with 9 deaths and cumulative incidence 2.83/100,000 - higher than the ~300 figure Sesal cites as its 2025 comparator, showing the 2025 baseline itself has multiple published values. 2026 geography: Francisco Morazan leads (Distrito Central the top municipality), then Cortes, Copan, Yoro/Olancho/El Paraiso depending on the report; urban concentration is atypical for a livestock-associated pest. Highest-risk group per Sesal: post-surgical patients and diabetics with foot ulcers or amputations. Regional context: Chiapas, Mexico forum (Ecosur, 2026-09-18) reports rancher under-reporting driven by quarantine fear, and sterile-fly releases underway in Mexico. Honduras's surveillance system is simultaneously handling dengue, measles, pertussis increases and a first imported chikungunya case (2026-09-04).

MARKETS: no prediction market on this quantity located on Polymarket, Manifold, or Kalshi; Polymarket's only screwworm contract concerns US livestock detections.

SEARCHED FOR BUT NOT FOUND: any Sesal figure above 299; any figure dated 2026-09-19 through 2026-09-21; a numbered Sesal boletin epidemiologico or sala de situacion PDF for 2026 containing a miasis line item; a published Sesal schedule for surveillance-report releases; any PAHO/OPS bulletin restating the Honduran human total; any statement of the data cut-off date (semana epidemiologica) behind the 299 figure.
calls.reference_class: Fortnightly Sesal-announced cumulative 2026 human screwworm myiasis totals for Honduras, Jan-Sep 2026 (n=8 observed announcements), combined with the empirical distribution of gaps between those announcements

calls.reasoning: Reference class is Sesal's own 2026 cumulative human-myiasis series: last announced figure 299 (Sep 16, Homer Mejia, Unidad de Vigilancia de la Salud), with a YTD rate of 1.16 cases/day and a last-interval rate of 1.24/day; naive continuation over the 15 days to the Oct 1 announcement deadline gives ~316. The binding uncertainty is announcement cadence, not case accrual: gaps between distinct publicly cited figures since May were 22, 8, 18, 17, 36 and 34 days, and the last two exceeded the remaining window, so ~40% of my mass sits exactly at 299 (a Sep 18 El Heraldo piece already re-cited 299 rather than updating it). Countervailing: the Sep 16 Distrito Central health alert raises reporting frequency, and crossing 300 — equaling all of 2025 — is an irresistible headline, so ~58% on a higher figure, median increment ~13. Downside escape below 290 only via a downward revision to lab-confirmed-only (fine print explicitly lets a revision govern), priced 2%; upside above 380 would need >5.4 cases/day, priced 1%. No prediction market prices this question — Kalshi's kxscrewwormcount covers U.S. human cases, a different country and resolution source, so it is not an anchor. Evidence is decent on the series but thin on Sesal's update calendar, so I stay close to a mixture of status quo and naive continuation.

calls.reasoning: The question resolves off an ANNOUNCEMENT, not off incidence, so the binding uncertainty is Sesal's discretionary press cadence rather than case accrual. 299 was announced Sep 16 and re-cited Sep 18; nothing higher exists as of Now, so 299 is the floor and annulment is dead. For a higher figure the Sep 16 -> next gap must be <= 15 days; historically only ~1-3 of 8 gaps were, the two most recent were 16 and 34 days, and 5 of the 15 days have already elapsed silently. The strongest pro-update mechanism - press demand around the 300 milestone plus the Sep 16 Distrito Central alert - was already tested on Sep 18, when two surveillance roundups restated 299 instead of getting a fresh number. I put ~48% on a new figure (below Runs 2 and 3, near Run 1), ~50% on 299 standing, ~2% on a revision. Conditional on an update landing mid-to-late window at ~1.2 cases/day, the increment is +10 to +18, median ~311.
calls.reconciliation: Three factual points settled from the dossiers. (1) Time remaining: the runs quote 13, 15 and 10.7 days; measured from Now the live window is 10.7 days, and the operative test is whether the Sep 16 gap closes within 15 days - with 5 already spent. Run 3's 15-day framing inflated its update probability and I discount its 20-25% status-quo mass accordingly. (2) Run 2's 'last two gaps were 36 and 34 days' is wrong: it dropped the Jul 28 = 246 figure that Runs 1 and 3 both attest to Infobae. Corrected sequence 22, 8, 18, 17, 20, 16, 34 - denser than Run 2 believed, but still only the 8-day gap falls under 15 on the common list. (3) No figure above 299 exists as of 2026-09-21 per three independent searches; 299 is the floor and annulment is not live. Two factual disputes could NOT be settled without web access and I let them carry their uncertainty: whether the 299 is lab-confirmed-only or includes clinically compatible cases (Run 2's definitional flag - this is the mechanism for the 1.5% downside escape), and the 2025 comparator (287-300 per Sesal vs 306 confirmed in the LATAM paper), which affects only how sharp the milestone press hook is, not resolution. The remaining dispute is pure judgment: P(fresh announcement). No evidence breaks it, so I take the reading I would bet on - the Sep 18 roundups restating 299 rather than updating is the most informative single datum, a direct post-alert test of the press-pressure mechanism that came back negative, so I sit at 48%, below Runs 2 and 3. I carry Run 1's reference class (the series' own gap-and-increment behaviour) forward because I agree with it; my dispersion is narrower than all three runs' 22-26 only in that I state the mixture explicitly - the point mass at 299 is a real feature of the resolution instrument, not clipping. I did not average the runs: my median sits below all three because the status-quo branch holds just over half the mass.
